audience_problem: A fictional adult arranges three clear comparison boxes beside a shopping card and discovers why an attractive price alone is incomplete.

payoff.text: The empty boxes were the useful part.

packaging.title: Three Boxes Before the Buy Button
packaging.promise: Blank comparison boxes turn an incomplete shopping impression into an explicit checklist.
packaging.evidence_anchor: The empty boxes were the useful part.

sources.claim: FTC online-shopping guidance advises comparing product details and the total cost, including shipping/delivery and other fees.

retention_beats.purpose: Narration turn: FTC shopping guidance says to compare product details and include delivery and other fees.
Narration turn: Atomy or another shop, he completes the comparison before choosing. The empty boxes were the useful part.

experiment.assignment_note: Three videos per variant across three topic families. Observational matched batch, not a randomized causal test.

review_scope: Packaging-to-script alignment reviewed. No claim of audience performance or automatic fact checking.
